Biomedical Sciences BSc at University College London

What University College London asks of applicants to Biomedical Sciences BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University College London courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 0 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (UCL’s AAA band, this course’s offer): 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1440 or ACT 32, taken in the final three years of high school, with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Alternatively 5,5,5,5 in four APs (taken in the final three years of high school), with no SAT/ACT

Chain: the 2027-entry course page (offer AAA) loads UCL’s international equivalency for its A-level band through its country selector; that data’s United States entry is shown here. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026UCL: Biomedical Sciences BSc (2027 entry) · UCL: 2027 international equivalency — United States (AAA band)
English language
  • UCL English language Level 4
  • IELTS Academic: 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in each component
  • TOEFL iBT (tests from 21 January 2026): 5.5 overall and 5.0 in each skill; earlier tests: 109 overall with 27/30 in reading and writing and 23/30 in speaking and listening
  • PTE Academic: 80 overall with at least 76 in each communicative skill
  • Not needed by nationals of UCL’s listed majority English-speaking countries (including the USA); for September 2027 entry a test must be taken on or after 1 September 2025

Other accepted tests and qualifications (e.g. Cambridge C1/C2, GCSE/IGCSE English) are listed on UCL’s English language page; 12 months of English-taught education in an approved country (including the USA) leading to a qualification also counts. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: accepted — see note
  • Advanced Placement (UCL’s AAA band): 5,5,5,5 in four APs, or 5,5 in two APs plus SAT 1440 or ACT 32 with the High School Graduation Diploma
  • Subject requirements carry over:
    • an A* or A subject needs a 5 in the relevant full-year AP (a B needs a 4)
    • where Mathematics or Physics is required, specific AP subjects are asked for
  • AP scores must be verified and sent to UCL by the College Board

UCL’s 2027 international equivalency for the AAA band, which the course page’s country selector loads for this course. UCL also says one year at a recognised US university or college (CGPA 3.3/4.0, around 30 semester credits) may be considered. Awaiting a manual check: the official page could not be re-read automatically, so this has not been re-confirmed.
